subject: Vendor portal proofing playbook — SOC 2 / CAIQ gap clarification
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Vendor Security Team <security@finbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor portal proofing playbook — SOC 2 / CAIQ gap clarification

Hi Emily / FinBank team,

Thanks again for taking the time earlier this week to start the Vendr profile. We're kicking off a short evidence-onboarding pass so Redwood can validate controls and map items back to our SOC 2 / SIG checklist before the contract is finalized. A couple specific asks to keep this tight: 

- Which portal are you actively maintaining (Vendr / OneTrust / Whistic / other)? I see a partially populated Vendr profile but several fields are blank.
- Please share the current SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) and the evidence/artefact links for the following control areas: user provisioning, key management, logging/retention, and incident response.
- For CAIQ/SIG mapping: do you have an export (CSV/Excel) of your CAIQ answers or a SIG questionnaire we can ingest? If not, we can provide a template.
- Preferred upload mechanism: presigned S3, Vendr attachments, or SFTP? We prefer presigned upload URLs for automation.

I've attached a short "redwood-evidence-checklist.pdf" and a SIG template (sig-template.xlsx) to help standardize fields we need. Can your team aim to upload the initial bundle by EOD Tuesday (2027-05-25)? If that timeline is tight, let us know the blocker and we can scope a minimal set to unblock the procurement review.

Thanks — this should be a quick pass if we align on the upload flow.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Security Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-evidence-checklist.pdf (checklist for Vendr/Whistic/OneTrust), sig-template.xlsx (SIG/CAIQ mapping template)
From: Emily Saunders <emily.saunders@finbank.com>

Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 10:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor portal proofing playbook — SOC 2 / CAIQ gap clarification

Olga — thanks for the clear checklist and the SIG template. Quick answers below and next steps: 

- We maintain a Vendr profile (https://vendr.example.com/profile/finbank). The profile was started by procurement but security owns the evidence uploads.
- We can provide the SOC 2 Type II 2026 PDF and a small evidence bundle for the control areas you listed.
- We have a CAIQ export but it's been updated in our internal tool; we'll map to your template.
- Upload preference: presigned S3 links work for us — please provide the upload URLs and expected manifest format.

Timeline: We can upload a minimal bundle by Tue 5/25 if you can provide presigned links and the manifest schema today. We will attach the SOC 2 report in our reply once we've confirmed the presigned flow.

I'll loop in our SRE contact (cc'd) if we need any technical assistance on the S3 side.

—Emily
Emily Saunders
Head of Information Security — FinBank
security@finbank.com

Subject: Re: Vendor portal proofing playbook — SOC 2 / CAIQ gap clarification

Emily — great, thanks. Quick notes and I've attached the manifest example inline (also in redwood-evidence-checklist.pdf):

- Manifest/metadata we expect per upload: filename, control_area (SOC2 control id or CAIQ domain), evidence_type (policy, screenshot, log-export), date_collected, custodian_name. JSON/CSV both acceptable.
- We'll generate presigned PUT URLs for a temporary bucket (48-hour TTL) and share them via the Vendr profile (private links) or directly in this thread if easier.
- Minimal bundle to unblock procurement: SOC2 report (PDF), IAM user-provisioning policy (PDF), KMS key rotation statement or CMK metadata, logging sample (1 week of anonymized logs), incident response policy.

Also: two operational questions for your SRE folks:
1) Are uploaded artefacts expected to be encrypted server-side (SSE-S3 or SSE-KMS)? We prefer SSE-KMS and request the KMS key alias so we can catalog provenance.
2) Do you have an existing evidence rotation cadence (annual/quarterly)? If you rotate keys/evidence more frequently, tell us the TTL we should set on our side.

If you can send the presigned URLs today, we'll validate the upload and confirm mapping to CAIQ.

Thanks,
Olga

Attachments referenced: redwood-evidence-checklist.pdf (manifest example)

Hi Olga — thanks for the manifest example. We're ready to proceed and have attached the initial artefacts. Upload method below: 

- Presigned PUT URLs generated (48h TTL). Upload manifest must be CSV with columns: filename,control_area,evidence_type,date_collected,custodian_name.
- Server-side encryption: SSE-KMS (alias: aws/kms/finbank-proofs) — we will encrypt artefacts on upload.
- Evidence rotation: annual for SOC artifacts, quarterly for operational logs.

Attachments (attached to this message):
- FinBank_SOC2_TypeII_2026.pdf (SOC 2 Type II report)
- iam-provisioning-policy.pdf (IAM policy excerpt)
- kms-rotation-summary.pdf (KMS rotation cadence & CMK metadata)

Presigned links (private):
- https://s3-presign.finbank.example/redwood/put/abc123 (expires 2027-05-26T13:07:00Z)
- https://s3-presign.finbank.example/redwood/put/def456 (expires 2027-05-26T13:07:00Z)

Let us know once you validate the uploads and we'll mark the Vendr profile as complete.

—Emily
